about_the_game:
Experience a revolutionary way to play fantasy football with Fantasy Royale, the first game that gives you the power to adjust your lineup on a play-by-play basis. Gone are the days of setting your roster and hoping for the best; now you can react to the live action as it happens. See a mismatch? Swap in a new player. Is your star running back getting shut down? Sub him out for a hot hand.

Fantasy Royale is built for maximum engagement, with real-time scoring that reflects every catch, tackle, and touchdown the moment it occurs. Challenge your friends or test your skills against the world on our global leaderboards. With deep player analytics at your fingertips, you have all the data you need to make informed, strategic decisions that can turn the tide of any game. This is more than fantasy sports—it's your chance to manage your team and prove your strategic genius with every snap.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.12
  • Processor: Intel processor or Apple M1 chip
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 5000 or Apple M1 graphics
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Supports both Intel (x86_64) and Apple Silicon (arm64) processors. Requires macOS 10.12+ for Intel and macOS 11.0+ for Apple Silicon.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 chip or newer
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 integrated graphics or newer
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo or Equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with OpenGL 3.3 support (e.g., Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 620 or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

short_description: Unleash your inner coach with Fantasy Royale, the live fantasy football game that puts you in control of every single play. Make game-winning adjustments, swap players in real-time, and dominate your friends in fast-paced, head-to-head matchups.
